name: The Prison's Bindings
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You must retrieve bindings for the prison of the Doomguard from lesser demons.

The blood of the Wildspawn satyr that occupy Dire Maul should do nicely. The coagulated blood will bond the Hederine shards and power the crystal prison.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, a most excellent recovery. The blood will suppress the Doomguard's magical defenses.
narrative.requestItemsText: Only the blood of Wildspawn satyr will suffice.
